name: Eudora's Artichoke Ravioli
whyItWorks: Soft white-flour pasta pillows with a pureed artichoke and cheese filling are gentle to chew when ordered without fibrous vegetable garnishes.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order at Tiana's Place with melted butter or plain parmesan broth instead of the Meyer lemon white wine sauce if you follow a strict citrus guardrail, and push aside the whole sautéed spinach and cherry tomato skins.
watchOuts: Whole spinach leaves and blistered tomato skins
